name: Scenario 3: Canary Token Verification Latency
description: Auth service canary deployment exhibits elevated latency. OpsMind recalls auth-service topology and suggests cache warm-up.

payload.message: AuthService canary deployment v2.1.0 showing elevated JWT validation latency and session cache latency.
payload.raw_logs: WARN 2026-11-05T12:45:00Z [auth-service-canary] TokenValidationException: public key cache miss, latency 1200ms.

expected_triage.topology_context: auth-service is a Tier-1 authentication service issuing JWT tokens

resolution.confirmed_root_cause: Cold public key cache on newly provisioned canary pods
resolution.resolution_summary: Warmed up public key cache before shifting production canary traffic
resolution.lessons_learned: Always pre-warm JWT public key cache during canary rollout sequence.
